bibl.title: The Egerton Gospel (Egerton Papyrus 2 + Papyrus Köln VI 255). Introduction, Critical Edition, and Commentary

series.title: Texts and Editions for New Testament Study

bibl.seg: Lorne R. Zelyck, The Egerton Gospel (Egerton Papyrus 2 + Papyrus Köln VI 255). Introduction, Critical Edition, and Commentary = Texts and Editions for New Testament Study. 13.
Leiden - Boston, Brill, 2019, xiv-254 pp. ISBN 978-90-04-40932-3. €116.
C.R. par Daniel Sharp, JThS 72 (2021) pp. 426-428.
bibl.note: P. Egerton 2 + P. Köln VI, 255 (= van Haelst 586; LDAB 4736). - 1. Introduction. - 2. The acquisition and publication of the Egerton Gospel fragments. - 3. A description of the fragments. - 4. Transcription, reconstruction, and translation. - 5. A confrontation with the authorities (EG 1v.1-26 [P. Eg. 2, 1v.1-20 + P. Köln 255, 1v.1-6<]). - 6. An attempt to stone and arrest Jesus (EG 1r.1-10 [P. Eg. 2,1r.1-10]). - 7. The healing of a leper (EG 1r.11-24 [P. Eg. 2, 1r.11-20 + P. Köln 255, 1r.1-7]). - 8. Jesus' strange question (EG 2v.1-5 [P. Eg. 2, 2v.1-5]) and the miracle on the Jordan river (EG 2v.6-16 [P. Eg. 2, 2v.6-16]). - 9. The question of tribute (EG 2r.1-18 [P. Eg. 2, 2r.1-17<]). - 10. An unidentified txt (EG 3v.1-6 [P. Eg. 2, 3v.1-6]). - 11. Another attempt to stone Jesus (EG 3r.1-6 [P. Eg. 2, 3r.1-6]). - 12. Conclusion. - Appendix 1: Word statistics; - Appendix 2: Synoptic charts of parallel passages. - Bibliography. Indexes.
